chunks: And from him, from Al-Jamourani, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from Muhammad ibn Yusuf Al-Taymi, from Muhammad ibn Ja'far, from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The one who neglects marriage out of fear of poverty, has had a poor opinion of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.'
Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says: 'If they are poor, Allah will enrich them from His bounty.'
ai.seo_question: Why should one not delay marriage due to fear of poverty?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, this hadith links the spiritual act of marriage to divine provision (rizq), framing the fear of poverty as a deficiency in tawakkul (trust in God). It explicitly cites Surah An-Nur 24:32 to support the principle that God enriches the deserving from His bounty, a concept central to Shia jurisprudence regarding the encouragement of marriage for those capable of fulfilling its duties.
